Number pop-in, adapted from Transitions.dev by Jakub Antalik.
https://github.com/Jakubantalik/transitions.dev/blob/main/skills/transitions-dev/02-number-pop-in.md
https://transitions.dev/terms.html

The transitions and skills may be used, modified and shipped in unlimited
personal and commercial projects. Do not redistribute the library itself as
a competing transitions library or kit. CLI tooling is MIT.

Local adaptation scopes tokens to /explore, maps duration/easing/stagger to
portfolio tokens, and uses React keys to re-enter changed digits rather than
imperatively replacing DOM and forcing synchronous reflow.
